platforms.name: GitHub Actions
platforms.free_tier_notes: Public repositories are free; private repositories include a monthly hosted-runner allowance that varies by plan.
platforms.secret_management: GitHub Actions encrypted secrets and environments
platforms.best_for: Projects already hosted on GitHub that benefit from a large marketplace and repository-native checks.
platforms.limitations: Tightly coupled to GitHub and its hosted-runner minutes, permissions, and ecosystem.
platforms.pricing_summary: Free for public repositories; private usage has plan-specific included minutes and per-minute overages; check official pricing.

platforms.name: GitLab CI/CD
platforms.free_tier_notes: GitLab.com Free includes a monthly compute-minute allowance; self-managed runners avoid hosted-minute consumption.
platforms.secret_management: GitLab CI/CD variables, protected variables, and masked variables
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an integrated repository, merge-request, registry, security, and pipeline workflow.
platforms.limitations: Hosted compute limits and feature availability vary by tier; the integrated surface can be more complex to operate.
platforms.pricing_summary: Free tier available with included compute minutes; paid tiers and additional compute are usage/plan dependent; check official pricing.

platforms.name: CircleCI
platforms.free_tier_notes: The free plan is credit-based rather than a fixed minute allowance, so minutes are not directly comparable.
platforms.secret_management: Project environment variables, contexts, and restricted contexts
platforms.best_for: Teams that want a hosted CI service with strong parallelism, caching, and workflow orchestration.
platforms.limitations: Credit-based pricing and concurrency limits make cost forecasting less direct than a simple minute model.
platforms.pricing_summary: Free plan and paid usage are credit-based; included credits, concurrency, and compute costs vary by plan; check official pricing.

platforms.name: Jenkins
platforms.free_tier_notes: No hosted free-minute allowance; the open-source server and agents run on infrastructure you provide.
platforms.secret_management: Jenkins Credentials Binding and credential providers
platforms.best_for: Organizations that need maximum control, extensibility, and self-hosted execution across heterogeneous infrastructure.
platforms.limitations: You own upgrades, plugin compatibility, availability, security hardening, and all infrastructure costs.
platforms.pricing_summary: Jenkins is free and open source; hosting, administration, agents, and plugins can create operational cost.

platforms.name: Drone CI
platforms.free_tier_notes: No hosted free-minute allowance in the open-source server; execution uses self-managed runners.
platforms.best_for: Small teams that want a lightweight, container-native, self-hosted pipeline with simple YAML configuration.
platforms.limitations: Smaller ecosystem and more self-hosting responsibility than the large hosted platforms.
platforms.pricing_summary: Open-source Drone components are free; hosted and enterprise offerings have separate plan terms; check official pricing.
